## Change and reason

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and security impact.

## Validation

Record the commands and results. Explain any unavailable verification.

## Security review

- [ ] Input schemas and server-side authentication/authorization are preserved.
- [ ] No secrets, personal identifiers, private notes or local paths were added.
- [ ] No scanner suppressions or weakened tests/checks were added.
- [ ] Commit identities and trailers use approved noreply addresses.
- [ ] Any dependency is exact-pinned; registry identity, publisher, maintenance,
      repository and license were checked, with justification here.
- [ ] Security-relevant behavior has a regression test.
- [ ] Changes to identifier policy or known exceptions have owner review.
